Chart style setter adds style before removing existing style

#### Description

When setting a chart style to a non-None value, the new style is added before the existing style is removed, causing both styles to be present in the XML output.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData

# Create a presentation with a chart
prs = Presentation()
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])

# Add some chart data
chart_data = CategoryChartData()
chart_data.categories = ['East', 'West', 'Midwest']
chart_data.add_series('Series 1', (19.2, 21.4, 16.7))

# Create a chart
graphic_frame = slide.shapes.add_chart(
    XL_CHART_TYPE.COLUMN_CLUSTERED, 
    Inches(2), Inches(2), Inches(6), Inches(4.5), 
    chart_data
)
chart = graphic_frame.chart

# Set chart style - this should replace any existing style
chart.chart_style = 10
print(chart._chartSpace.xml)  # Shows both old and new style elements
```

The XML output contains duplicate style elements instead of just the new style.
</issue>
